paite: TOUPA aw, migilou a pan hon humbit inla; mingongtat a pan hon hum in;
heading: David Phatna La / Humbitna Dia Thumna

paite: amau alungtang uah thilhihkhelhte angaihtuah ua; dou ding in akikhawm uhi.
Alei uh gul bang in ahiamsak ua; akamsung uah thangtom gu a-om hi. Selah
TOUPA aw, migilou-salou khut lak ah hon kemhoih inla; mingongtat lak ah hon hum in; amau ka khe kalsuante sawnkawi atum uhi.
Mikisatheite'n ka awkna ding in thang aguk kam ua, khauhualte toh; lamsik ah len aphahua; ka awkna ding in thangte akam uhi. Selah
TOUPA kiang ah, nang zaw ka Pathian na hi; TOUPA aw, hehpih ka ngetna awte na bil na doh in.
TOUPA Pathian aw, ka hotdamna hatna aw, nang kisual ni chiah ka lu na hon khuhsak a,
TOUPA aw, migilou-salou deihlamte zaw phal ke'nla; angaihtuahna gilou pichingsak ke'n; huchi keileh akipahtawi kha ding uhi, ka chi a. Selah
Hon umsuakte lu amau muk a thugina lou agen un khuh hen.
Mei-amte atung uah kia henla; mei ah paih in om uhenla; athoh nawnlouhna ding un kokhuk thupitak ah paih in om uhen.
Thuhoih lou genpa lei ah hihkip in a-om kei ding a, mingongtat hihse ding in thil hoih lou in azong ding hi.
TOUPA'N gimthuakte agum ding chih ka thei, tagahte a ding in diktak in vai ahawm ding.
Pel lou in midiktatte'n na min aphat ding ua; na ma ah midikte a-om ding uhi.
